patterns: PYQs are mostly 'who said this quote' items (wrong means/right ends; morally wrong/politically right) with Gandhi among Nehru/Patel/Rajaji.
Single-concept items: last step of satyagraha = strike; cruellest violence = persistence of poverty; non-violence = way to attain truth.
Comparisons recur: Gandhism vs Marxism (common = stateless society), Gandhi vs Nehru (heavy industrialisation).
'NOT a feature / NOT true' framing is common (aim of satyagrahi is not to defeat the enemy).
App uses more multi-statement items; content matches PYQ facts closely.
